scope: Archived-project read/restore/result recovery, captured before application edits
evidence: Actual compiled ArchivedProjectList callbacks/JSX with installed React static rendering, QueryObserver, MutationObserver and existing runBatchSelection. State/ref/effect scheduling, transport/server rows and unrelated children are explicit doubles. No browser, service, PostgreSQL or real lost network response exercised.

control_correction: Ordinary invalidateQueries read failure is swallowed by TanStack Query defaults and does not call mutation onError. A successful write followed by a failed refresh was not established as the source of the still-archived error; the reproduced error is a simulated lost write acknowledgement.
defensive_checks: Same-turn duplicate callbacks and deletion during pending restoration were invoked explicitly; these are callback contracts, not observed real user/browser races.
